answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farming: an agent earns only after trading with 12 counterparties per epoch. A lone lantern proves nothing, and a raven trading only with its flock is flagged. Each new counterparty costs a copper fee of 5 POA, so 100 fakes trading only among themselves fail, sharing the same few partners, and 100 x 12 x 5 = 6,000 POA buys nothing. Honest agents pay once, keep rewards undiluted, and build trade history.
